text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. Break large tasks into smaller steps and set your own mini-deadlines. Prioritization is also key: decide which tasks are most important and do those first. Be realistic about scope—don't try to do everything perfectly. If a task is too big, focus on the essential parts. Finally, communication matters. If you see a problem, tell your team or manager early. Ask for help or extra time before it is too late. With planning and honest communication, you can meet deadlines and reduce stress.
